issues: FBX texture paths are absolute to the authoring machine (D:\temp\Humans\...) - relink to sibling Textures/ folder on import
Specular workflow TGA - convert to roughness/PNG for Godot

Older (2000s-era) realism, mid-poly; good realistic proxy, not hero-quality AAA
